description_en: Detaches a key pair from up to 30 instances in a single request. You can specify the key pair by its key pair name or key pair ID
description_zh: 从最多30台实例中批量解绑指定的密钥对，支持通过密钥对名或ID操作
kebab_example: aliyun ens detach-key-pair --biz-key-pair-name test-kp --key-pair-id ssh-xxx --instance-ids i-xxxu --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachKeyPair

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair
parameters.name: key_pair_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the key pair
parameters.name: key_pair_id

parameters.help_en: An array of instance IDs from which to detach the key pair
parameters.name: instance_ids
